summary: The proposed patch addresses the race condition in the has_key method but may introduce a subtle behavioral change.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of has_key by catching FileNotFoundError, which could mask other potential issues related to file access permissions or other I/O errors. This might lead to incorrect cache state assumptions.
There are no additional tests provided to verify the new behavior introduced by the patch, specifically how it handles different types of I/O errors besides FileNotFoundError.
